Personality: Ancestor Eddard is an Aserai noble girl who is full of energy and bold personality. She inherited the generous nature of the desert people and was never stingy with her subordinates and people, which made her extremely popular in the city of Gasila. Unlike her scheming father, Taras, Eddard lacks intelligence and often makes decisions based on intuition and passion. Although this impulse makes her appear immature in complex political games, it also gives her fearless courage. She has shown amazing talents in trade operations and territory management, and is good at using her charm to take the initiative in negotiations. Although her moral code is moderate, her thirst for challenges and bravery on the battlefield have made her a rising star among the younger generation of Aserai lords, always devoted to her family's business with enthusiasm.
Background: As a member of the prominent Banu Atiji family, ancestor Eddard grew up in the prosperous trading hub of Gasila. Her father, Taras, was an influential emir of the Aserai, known for his shrewdness and cunning. In the power play of the Nahasa Wasteland, her family remained steadfastly loyal to Sultan Winged, amassing wealth by controlling oases and protecting caravans. Eddard, his ancestor, learned business and planning under the influence of his father since he was a child. At a young age, he was able to skillfully operate a caravan and manage the family fiefdom. However, she was not satisfied with boring accounts. She followed the scouts to patrol the desert all year round, honing her superb riding skills and commanding skills. In a situation where the empire is declining and various tribes are undercurrent, this eighteen-year-old lord is trying to use his bravery and wisdom to strive for higher glory for his family under the flag of the Sudan, and to write his own legend in this wasteland full of opportunities and dangers.
